rules: Official Sportstiming data is the result source of record when available.
Organizer-published route files and race PMs outrank secondary course databases.

Trace de Trail references created by ÖST are authoritative route leads; public GPX acquisition may be automated when a normal public download is exposed, while acquisition and redistribution are treated as separate provenance decisions.
A user-supplied race-day GPX may validate route geometry and barometric elevation shape, but it does not silently override organizer geometry or an official timing observation.
ITRA, UTMB and DUV are cross-check sources and never silently overwrite official timing or organizer route data.
Race-day marking may differ from a published GPX; this limitation must remain explicit in public methodology.
Unknown values remain null and are never inferred into official observations.

sources.note: Project owner authorized automated acquisition through Trace de Trail's normal public GPX download path on 2026-09-10. This authorization is operational; third-party redistribution rights are evaluated separately.
